steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-12, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1228.3 | 0.41 | 0.41
2 | 678.3 | 0.50 | 0.91
3 | 2104.5 | 0.76 | 1.67
4 | 3417.4 | 29.87 | 31.54
5 | 3516.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as Q-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-12, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station T-12, Survey Area T**

The interpreted layer sequence shows resistivity values of 1228.3, 678.3, 2104.5, 3417.4, and 3516.3 Ω·m with depths to base at 0.41, 0.91, 1.67, and 31.54 m (layer 5 unbounded). The sequence first decreases (layer 1 to 2), then increases progressively through layers 3, 4, and 5.

Applying the standard three-layer curve-letter convention:
- Layers 1-2-3: r1 > r2 < r3 → H
- Layers 2-3-4: r2 < r3 < r4 → A
- Layers 3-4-5: r3 < r4 < r5 → A

This gives a curve type of **HAA**, not Q-type. A Q-type curve requires continuously decreasing resistivity with depth (r1 > r2 > r3 > r4 > r5), which is not observed here—resistivity decreases only once, then rises for the remaining three layers. The on-file classification does not match the computed layer resistivity pattern.

**Recommendation:** Flag the station record for interpretation review before drilling proceeds, as the labeled curve type conflicts with the resistivity data.

{"curve_type_stated": "HAA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
